description.value:
Duration constant

Nothing you make comes apart wrong any more, and the ones that do, you meant.

When an effect would make you roll on the Bloom Table, you choose the result instead, including Total Bloom. Once per day you may decline the roll entirely, and nothing happens.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Additionally, per this pass's confirmed vocabulary, no rule element lets a player pick a table result instead of rolling, or guarantees an outright success in place of a roll that would otherwise occur.
